title: Death of Hektor, from the "Death of Hektor" Portfolio
medium: Intaglio print from engraving and soft-ground etching on copper plate

events.who: Stanley William Hayter and Irish poet Brian Coffey
events.n: collaboration on the Death of Hektor portfolio
events.q: In 1979, Stanley William Hayter and Irish poet Brian Coffey collaborated on a dramatic reinterpretation of Homer's epic tale from The Iliad.

events.n: printer of some of the portfolio's plates
events.q: Some of the plates from the Hektor portfolio were printed by Hayter at Atelier 17 in Paris
